scope: bounded operators between separable Hilbert spaces with fixed support; norm-holomorphic frequency dependence

objects.interiorScale: a bounded positive operator T with fixed support P=projection onto closure(range(T))
objects.reducedInterior: a norm-holomorphic bounded operator Dhat(z) on P H_i that is boundedly invertible at every z in the upper half-plane
objects.compatibleCoupling: B=C T^(1/2), equivalently range(B*) is contained in range(T^(1/2)) with a bounded Douglas factor C

dispatcher.condition: T has closed range and the coupling annihilates its kernel
T may have non-closed range but B=C T^(1/2) with bounded C
dispatcher.topology: factorized form; strong regularization in the commuting spectral model
dispatcher.output: bounded factorized Schur response C Dhat^(-1) C*

dispatcher.condition: the factor C suppresses the low-spectrum tail uniformly (compact C is sufficient)
dispatcher.topology: operator norm under the declared commuting regularization

dispatcher.condition: B does not factor boundedly through T^(1/2)
dispatcher.output: unbounded correction; retain the interior or refuse elimination

dispatcher.condition: B has a component on kernel(T)
dispatcher.output: regulator divergence; fail the Ward/range gate

topologyLedger.norm: uniform operator control; stable under norm-continuous downstream operations
topologyLedger.strong: vectorwise control only; does not license norm, determinant, trace, or uniform spectral conclusions
topologyLedger.weak: matrix-element control only; retained as a distinct weaker option
topologyLedger.traceNorm: requires an additional Schatten-class residue condition

symmetries: unitary external and interior frame transport
factorization-gauge transport that leaves D, B and the reduced correction invariant
